notes.omupiira: Le foot, short for le football.
notes.nzannya: Je joue au… for sports and games.

guidebook.intro: Talk about free time, football, music and games. French “plays at” sports and games.

tips.title: Jouer au foot
body: For sports and games, **jouer à**: **Je joue au foot** (à + le = au), **Jouons aux cartes** (à + les = aux). For instruments, **jouer de**: **Je joue du tambour, de la guitare.**
To like doing something: **J’aime** + verb: **J’aime nager, j’aime chanter.**

tips.title: On a gagné !
body: **On** is the everyday “we”: **On a gagné !** (we won), **On a perdu** (we lost). It takes the **il** form of the verb.
Asking who won: **Qui a gagné ?** A goal is **un but**, and fans shout **But !**

culture.title: Le foot
body: Football is the passion of francophone Africa. The national teams have nicknames: Cameroon’s **Lions indomptables**, Senegal’s **Lions de la Teranga**, DR Congo’s **Léopards**.
